Usage: netlist [--help] [--output] [--format] input

Positional arguments:
  input         Input file

Optional arguments:
  -h, --help    shows help message and exits
  -o, --output  Output file name
  --format      Netlist output format, valid options: kicadsexpr, kicadxml, cadstar, orcadpcb2, spice, spicemodel
